  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: data_issue
      description: The WebSurfer may fail to extract the specific city name from the visible text or misinterpret the SECU address as the conference HQ.
      severity: 0.5
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Planner receives incorrect location data (e.g., Birmingham instead of Atlanta).
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner might incorrectly update its understanding or issue further instructions based on false premises.
    - type: loop_issue
      description: The WebSurfer repeatedly returns the same search result page without navigating to the actual source URLs (e.g., secsports.com, Britannica) despite instructions to do so.
      severity: 0.7
      if_from_agent_wrong: The WebSurfer stays on the search engine results page (SERP) instead of visiting the authoritative sites.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Planner is forced to re-instruct the WebSurfer to visit the sites, creating a cycle of "search -> see SERP -> re-instruct -> search" without progress.
